[quote=the_commonwealth_provisional_states;61689999][b]Rooke Air Force Base, DeWitt Island, Bookerman Island Territory[/b]

"So..." Colonel William Kelders says, as he moves his cigarette down from his mouth

"This is that b*stard plane, yeah...?" he says, pointing at the radar contact on the screen. Kelders is the overall Wing Commander of Rooke Air Force Base, a relatively isolated installation with only 10 aircraft on the small island of Dewitt in the Bookerman Territories. He's held this position for most of his career as a Colonel. Even worse, he got stuck with barely trained Xeno pilots, who flew the ever-aging F-6s; they had become a nightmare to maintain, but typically Rooke didn't see much action, just the rare emergency landing or monthly air drill.

Lt Colonel Ellemijn Muler looks at the screen as well. "It would appear so, Colonel. It seems they are off course."

Muler notices the grin forming on Kelder's face, which is never good with him

"Colonel...if I may ask, what are you planning..." 

He looks to the sea from his command post and picks up his radio

"Something that is either going to get us court martialed or decortated." The colonel replies, picking up the radio to his right

_________________________________________________________________________

First Lieutenant Roch Auguste stares down the chessboard before him. In front of him, his Weapon Systems Officer for his F-6, First Lieutenant Phil Vérany is playing the white peice, other members of his squadron, having placed bets on either Verany or Auguste, wait in anticipation

"Phil...my man, you know if you don't want to embarrass yourself, you can give up, I mean, I already have you on the ropes." Roch says confident in his incoming victory, Roch like all of the xeno pilots at base, had signed up as a part of the "Double V" movement that had begun to rise up in Wuloosyan Xeno Community. It was believed by service that these men could be brought to nearer equality with their human compatriots. Their dreams, however, would be dashed as they would be asigned to this blasted island.

Phil Vérany looks at him, confused, "Ropes? Uh...you know I have the material advantage, right?"

"Yeah sure sure phill, believe - " Roch almost gets out before suddenly, the base alarm blurts on 

"This is Wing Commander Colonel William Kelders, Scramble 2 Alert Aircraft,  immediate launch for air defense intercept. Vectors to follow. Authenticate Hotel Romeo. Acknowledge and launch."

All of the pilots in the room immeditaly drop what they're doing and begin rushing to their aircraft, only a few hundred yards run, there were only 2 combat-ready F-6s at the base, which happened to be Verany and Auguste's aircraft, upon arriving in the hangar, they would dawn there G-suit, helmet, and survival gear as ground crews ran final check, the hanger doors rolled open as they leaped into the aircraft. The F-6 would roar to life as they taxied onto the runway behind the other combat-ready F-6s

"This is ground control, Spartan 01, cleared for takeoff runway 27, wind 250 at 12."

Once in position, Spartan 01 would take off from the airbase, then...

"This is ground control, Spartan 02, cleared for takeoff runway 27, wind 250 at 12."

Auguste would push down on the stick, retracting the gear once the aircraft was clearly in the air. 

"Excited? Vernany?" Augeste would say over the plane's internal intercom 

Verany would chuckle, "Are you seriously asking if I am excited we get to fly these dam things?"

"You know what we're even doing, looks like we're intercepting some sort of transport plane."

Verany would signal that he has no idea. The F-6s would continue their flight uninterrupted until they were on approach to Strom's aircraft. They would first visibly pull up on the sides of the aircraft, so that the pilots of the aircraft could see them, they would begin flashing there navigation lights, a common way of telling pilots that they were being intercepted, Augueste goes a step further then Spartan 01, and jumps infront of the aircraft and does an abrupt turn, singaling that the F-6s are demanding the aircraft follow them immeditalay as Spartan 01 jumps behind the aircraft and locks on a AIM-9 to the aircraft incase they fail to comply. Neither has any idea who is actually in the aircraft. To make the message even clearer, Augeste goes over the radio channel

"Attention unidentified aircraft, you are being intercepted and will follow us back to Rooke Air Force Base immediately, if you refuse, you will be shot down."[/quote]

The pilot of the plane had been asked to ensure the safety of his passengers, who allegedly were high ranking Rosenmarkket officials, however, he had seen who was onboard, the former Chief Consul of Rosenmarkke. Not wanting to cause a potential disaster he averted course and prepared to land.

Haakon had been asleep when he was awakened by Begren, Sir we have been ordered to land, he began.

By whom?! He demanded.

I am guessing Wuloosya? Said Begren.

No! Shouted Haakon, ripping off his seatbelt.

Please remain calm sir, we will sort this out when we land, Began Begren, They legally cannot hurt us,

Thus as the plane descended towards the Wuloosyan base, the passengers onboard readied themselves for what they assumed would be a very awkward moment.
